## About
I am an early-career statistician specializing in longitudinal and multilevel data analysis, causal inference, spatial statistics, missing data techniques, and Bayesian methods. I earned an M.S. in Statistics from the [University of New Mexico](https://www.unm.edu/) in 2025 and a B.Sc. double major in Mathematics and Statistics from the [University of Ghana](https://www.ug.edu.gh/) in 2021.  

My research focuses on developing and applying innovative statistical methodologies to solve complex challenges in public health and biomedical research. By combining advanced modeling with real-world data, I aim to generate insights that drive evidence-based decision-making and improve patient outcomes. I am committed to transforming complex data into clear, actionable findings through methodological rigor, thoughtful analysis, and effective communication.  

:::
